vision.name: Saiyan Swift Sword Drill
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 0.
(Limit 1 per deck.)
[Continuous]: Whenever you perform an attack with "Sword" in the title your MP may pay 1 stage to make that attack deal +1 stage and +1 life card.
[Instant] POWER: [Trait:Earthling]: If you have 2 or less Traits, use after performing a successful Styled or Named attack that has "Sword" in the title. That attack gains Remain 1.
(Created by Jordan Syverson, OP1 Supreme Kai Champion)
